Good question! 🌿

**If you've used the free shipping, you wouldn't be eligible for the full refund.** The 14-day refund only applies when no Leafy Plus benefits have been used. Once a benefit is used, there's no refund, even if you're still within the 14 days.

**What happens instead:**
- You would **not get a refund** of the $59 membership.
- Your Leafy Plus benefits would **continue until the end of the paid year**, so you'd still get free Standard shipping, the 90-day guarantee on plants ordered while you're a member, and the other perks.

**A tip if you're unsure:** Hold off on using any member perks, including free shipping, until you're happy with Leafy Plus. That way the full refund stays available if you cancel within 14 days.

If you'd like to talk through whether Leafy Plus suits how you shop, I'm happy to help. Is there anything else I can help you with? Happy planting! 🪴
